title: Verilator compile error (no UVM errors) must not be reported as a clean pass
source: Synthetic (eval/synthetic/compile_error). Exercises Phase-2 diagnosis C: non-UVM / compile errors dropped -> false PASS.

ground_truth.notes: Log contains Verilator %Error compile diagnostics and 'Exiting due to 2 error(s)' but zero UVM_ERROR lines. The current parser finds 0 errors -> pass_fail=PASS -> Agent 2 declares 'no failure'. Correct behaviour: recognise a build/compile failure.
